subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship an experimental Rovo provider only after the undocumented `credits/check` billing-site contract is verified, or pause the provider until Atlassian exposes a supported contract?
rationale: The remaining question is not a mechanical implementation choice: it determines whether CodexBar should depend on an undocumented credentialed endpoint whose site-selection semantics cannot currently be established from public documentation.

options.title: Verify before merge
options.body: Resolve the source conflict and require authoritative or entitled-account proof of the exact billing-site request contract before enabling the provider.

options.title: Accept experimental account-level behavior
options.body: Explicitly accept that the provider may be incomplete or incorrect for multi-site accounts and document that limitation before merge.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Defer this integration until Atlassian publishes or confirms a stable supported API contract.

recommendation.title: Verify before merge
recommendation.body: Resolve the source conflict and require authoritative or entitled-account proof of the exact billing-site request contract before enabling the provider.

likelyOwner.reason: The maintainer has already performed the provider hardening and explicitly paused merge on this external-contract decision.
